Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with a barbiturate, a tricyclic antidepressant, alcohol, a potassium-containing preparation, a licorice-containing preparation, a preparation containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, a loop diuretic (furosemide, ethacrynic acid) or a thiazide diuretic (trichlormethiazide). entries.출혈성뇌졸중, 구역·구토, 목마름(지속적이거나 심한), 변비, 식욕부진,: If hemorrhagic stroke, nausea and vomiting, thirst (persistent or severe), constipation, loss of appetite, rash and redness, itching, difficulty in urinating, headache, facial flushing, abnormal sensitivity to light, or, rarely, symptoms of shock (urticaria, swelling, a stifling feeling in the chest and the like immediately after taking it, together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweat and difficulty in breathing) occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.클로르헥시딘 제제 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는: Patients with hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine preparations, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, and breast-feeding women should not use this medicine. Do not use it on the mucous membrane surfaces of the brain, the spinal cord, the eyes, the ears (the inner ear, the middle ear, the outer ear), the vagina, the bladder, the mouth and the like, or on the eyes. Before using this medicine, people who have experienced hypersensitivity to this medicine or an allergic reaction such as asthma and patients with an allergic constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Since contact with the eyes may cause damage to the cornea, be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get in, wash it out well immediately with clean water. Since soaps weaken the germicidal action of this medicine, wash them off thoroughly before use. Do not use it for obstetric and gynecological purposes (disinfection of the vagina, the vulva, etc.) or for urological purposes (disinfection of the external genitalia, mucous membrane surfaces, etc.).
Do not use it together with a tetracycline antibiotic.
